name: ChartFrame
description:
The shell every chart renders in. It is a size container (R7.3) that fills its parent; the
box picks the tier on both axes (see tier.ts). It owns the head row (title, legend or
readout, and in the full tier the "View as table" toggle and "Copy as CSV"), the in-place
loading, empty and error states (R9.1), and the table fallback. The tools are present,
disabled, while the chart loads, so the head does not move when the data arrives (R9).
The parent must give it a definite height.
signature: ({ kind, label, title, state, emptyText, errorText, onRetry, table, head, compactHead, trail, trailOptional, trailSize, rule, children, className, locale: localeProp, ...rest }: ChartFrameProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: compactHead
props.description:
Whether the head row exists in the compact tier (it always does in full). Fixed per chart
type so the skeleton and the loaded chart share one geometry.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: One factual line for the empty state (R2.5): "No samples in the last hour".

props.name: errorText
props.description: What failed and what to do (R2.4): "Agent offline — retry when NST-C106 reconnects".

props.name: head
props.description: Legend or readout for the head row (compact and full tiers).

props.name: kind
props.description: Semantic entity or content kind, used to choose labels and rendering.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name: what is plotted, for what, over when ("CPU · NST-C106 · last hour").

props.name: locale
props.description:
BCP 47 locale for this chart's numbers, dates and table. Default: the nearest
`LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`, then en-US.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called with no arguments when the person presses Retry in the error state. The button appears only when this is set, `state` is "error" and the tier is not micro.

props.name: rule
props.description: The typed disclosure or validation rule applied to this value.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled view state, including loading, empty and error states.

props.name: table
props.description:
The data as a table: visually hidden for screen readers, shown with "View as table", and
copied by "Copy as CSV" (raw `values` where the model has them).

props.name: title
props.description: A visible label in Metric's label role. Omit inside a panel whose header already names it.

props.name: trail
props.description: Content after the plot in the micro tier (the latest value, a share).

props.name: trailOptional
props.description: The trail is a nicety: it hides in narrow rows so the marks keep their room.

props.name: trailSize
props.description:
The trail's reserved width, so loading and loaded share one geometry: a bare `value`
("44.4%") or a `figure` (label and value, about a third of the row).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
